purpose: Teach: キックオフ/型式/買い取っ/アダプター/コネクタ/ブランク/送り出す/圏外

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新年度のキックオフ会議もされますね
lines.en: The police department runs kickoff meetings for the new fiscal year, don't they?
lines.style: Warm, conversational observation. Gentle rising inflection at the end, inviting agreement. The tone of someone genuinely impressed by the thoroughness of an organization.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査車両の型式変更時に届出されますね
lines.en: And you have to file a notification whenever you modify an investigation vehicle, right?
lines.style: Continuing the same impressed, curious thread. Leaning in slightly with the question. Light, natural rhythm—not interrogating, just following the logic.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、押収品を国が買い取って差押える事もありますね
lines.en: The government sometimes purchases seized items directly to place them under asset freeze, I understand.
lines.style: Slightly more formal on this one—acknowledging a more complex procedure. Still warm. Speaking to show understanding, not to test knowledge.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、無線機のアダプターを多種ご用意ですね
lines.en: You keep a wide variety of radio adapters on hand, too.
lines.style: Appreciative observation. Slight smile in the voice. Noticing the practical thoroughness without making it sound surprising.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯カメラのコネクタ点検もされますね
lines.en: And you maintain the security camera connectors regularly, I see.
lines.style: Same warm admiration continuing. Matter-of-fact but appreciative. Nodding along with the list of careful procedures.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、配備のブランク期間を作らない様シフトされますね
lines.en: You shift your deployment schedule so there's never a gap in coverage, is that right?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity with admiration underneath. Warm question mark at the end. Following the thread of meticulous planning.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新型機を現場に送り出す前に訓練されますね
lines.en: And you train officers on new equipment before sending it out into the field.
lines.style: Still warm and admiring. Slight emphasis on the care that takes. Nodding confirmation of what he's learning.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、山中での圏外対策の無線中継もされますね
lines.en: You also set up radio relay stations for dead zones in mountainous areas.
lines.style: Closer now, more intimate. Quieter, more thoughtful observation. The tone shifts to something more personal—recognition of work that doesn't get noticed.
